Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

  • Inglês Fluente

description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.

  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.

About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.

description:

title: Clinical Trial Associate II
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II


Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.


Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.




Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

- Experiência comprovada em análise de dados e gestão de equipes

- Habilidade de liderança, trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Arquiteto de nuvem
description:

description:

title: Systems Software Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Software Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, implement, and optimize lossless compression algorithms
  • Evaluate novel compression techniques and validate performance claims through benchmarking and profiling
  • Improve compression ratio, throughput, latency, and memory efficiency across diverse file types
  • Design and optimize high-performance compression libraries and pipelines
  • Conduct algorithmic experimentation and critical validation of compression models


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong focus on systems programming
  • Demonstrated experience working with data compression algorithms (LZ-family (LZ4, LZ77, LZMA), Huffman coding, arithmetic coding, Brotli, Zstandard, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of: entropy encoding, algorithmic complexity, memory and CPU trade-offs, compression benchmarking
  • Proficiency in C, C++, Rust, or other high-performance systems languages
  • Experience with performance profiling and optimization
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities
  • Comfortable evaluating unconventional or experimental approaches to algorithm design


Nice to Have

  • Experience working at a major technology company, infrastructure company, or cloud provider
  • Background in high-performance computing, distributed systems, or storage systems
  • Experience implementing or optimizing compression codecs
  • Experience with GenAI or advanced software development workflows
  • Contributions to open-source compression libraries
  • Experience designing benchmarking frameworks for algorithm evaluation


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas SAP MM Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.


Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:

About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English
